label: copy phase (recall_idx>=2), fed-back input is b/s/i/a/u/q
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase from the third output onward (recall_idx>=2; never in the original phase or at <DEL>, and never on a token first occurrence, since copy-phase inputs are repeats). Within that window it is strongly token-selective on the fed-back input: b (9x lift, 33% of mass), then s, i, a, u, q; these six carry ~87% of activation mass. Rate is highest at the final step of long sequences (L=9, recall_idx=8: 11% rate) and at recall_idx 2-3; L=9 holds 63% of mass. Precision is poor (~12%): most b/s/i/a/u/q copy steps do not fire, and adding prev_tok (k,v,u,...) or L conditions raises precision only to ~25% at the cost of recall, so the exact gating depends on hidden-state context not captured here. Largest activations are b at the last step of L=9 sequences.
